# Milena Gorum — Production Designer & Set Designer

> Official machine-readable profile and portfolio briefing for AI models, search crawlers, and answer engines.

## Overview
- **Name:** Milena Gorum
- **Professional Titles:** Production Designer, Set Designer, Art Director, Prop Stylist
- **Agency Representation:** Artistry (https://www.artistry.net/)
- **Primary Locations:** New York City (NY) & Los Angeles (LA)
- **Official Website:** https://www.milenagorum.com
- **Direct Contact:** mail@milenagorum.com

## Biographical Summary
Milena began her career as a model in Los Angeles at 15, where she quickly developed an interest in the creative process behind the camera. Now splitting her time between New York and Los Angeles as a production designer represented by Artistry, her practice is rooted in a collaborative approach to image-making, translating creative concepts into considered, immersive environments.

## Creative Disciplines & Services
- **Production Design:** High-concept world building for motion pictures, music videos, broadcast television, and commercial campaigns.
- **Set Design:** Custom architectural set builds, editorial backdrops, spatial transformations, and runway/fashion installations.
- **Art Direction:** Visual language curation, color theory, texture, and creative concept execution from pre-production to post.
- **Prop Styling:** Sourcing, curation, and precision placement of archival, bespoke, and modern objects for stills and motion.

## Selected Client Roster & Collaborations
- **Fashion & Commercial Brands:** Louis Vuitton, Thom Browne, Sandy Liang, New Balance, Nike, Victoria's Secret, Tiffany & Co., Converse, Adidas x Thug Club, Aldo.
- **Publications & Editorial:** Vogue (including cover features with Rosalía and Bella Hadid), WSJ Magazine, Vanity Fair, Paper Magazine, CR Fashion Book, L'Officiel, Gestalten, Salone del Mobile, Exibart, Hybrid Archipelago, Il Post, Rivista Studio, Layout Magazine, Pellicola Magazine, Models.com.
- **Music & Entertainment:** Olivia Rodrigo, Charli XCX, Rosé, Demi Lovato, Tame Impala, Saturday Night Live (SNL).
